neighbours.label: ' enough' closing an emphatic praise idiom ('can't say enough about', 'can't thank them enough')
fire: We cannot thank the volunteers enough for their hard work.
I can't recommend this little bakery enough to visitors.
My wife and I could not praise the guide enough after the tour.
Honestly, we can't say enough good things about the movers.
The teacher was wonderful and we can't thank her enough.
I cannot stress enough how helpful the front desk staff were.
Our family can't say enough about the care our father received.
You can't praise this kind of customer service enough.
quiet: We want to thank the volunteers again for their hard work.
I would recommend this little bakery to most visitors.
My wife and I said goodbye to the guide after the tour.
Honestly, we have only good things to say about the movers.
The teacher was wonderful and we thanked her twice.
I want to stress how helpful the front desk staff were.
Our family is happy about the care our father received.
You rarely find this kind of customer service these days.

notes: Card: no dominant token; examples include 'can not say enough about it', 'typing like a boss', 'Flip's life', ' Airport'. Probe: 'can't say enough' 0.49 and 0.67, 'fast enough to' 0.05, Airport 0.33-0.36 (not covered here).
